friction_section.title: The Friction Point
friction_section.subtitle: Accounting firms manage client documents, tax deadlines, bookkeeping tasks, compliance reminders, and financial reporting across disconnected manual workflows.

cards.title: Manual Client Document Collection
cards.description: Invoices, receipts, bank statements, tax forms, payroll records, and bookkeeping files often require repeated follow-ups and manual tracking.

cards.title: Disconnected Financial Workflows
cards.description: Client communication, bookkeeping updates, tax preparation, reporting tasks, and deadline tracking are often spread across separate systems.

cards.title: Missed Deadline Risks
cards.description: Without automated reminders and task visibility, firms risk delays during tax season, VAT filing, payroll processing, and monthly reporting cycles.
